page.overview:
Who is Ancient Gear Beast?

Ancient Gear Beast is a character version of the card, "Ancient Gear Beast".

Ancient Gear Beast appears in the video game Yu-Gi-Oh! World Championship 2007. By beating it five times, the player gets closer to unlocking Level Three Duelists and a new Booster Pack.

In World Championship 2007, Ancient Gear Beast plays an "Ancient Gear" Deck titled, "Ancient Knowledge".
